verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents outbound webhooks: you set up a webhook of a given type, such as `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED`, whose payload carries screening results. Each delivery includes a `webhook-id` header to use as an idempotency key, and signing is available as an opt-in per account. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types beyond WORKFLOW_COMPLETED, detail on how endpoints are registered (API vs UI) and on retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
